entities.summary: Sarah Beth Grey is a British tennis player who specializes in doubles. She has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 128, achieved on 5 August 2024. She also has a best singles ranking of No. 277, achieved on 1 August 2022. Grey has won one singles title and 26 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit. Sarah Beth Grey was a athletes & competitors from Liverpool (b. 1995-08-10, Liverpool). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
